name: The End AI Trend: Your Dog or Cat Waving Goodbye, Then It Runs Off
blurb: The End is an AI trend where your dog or cat waving goodbye becomes a tiny movie: it walks up to the camera on its hind legs, waves one paw, then runs off down a city road while a soft voice says "The end." You need one clear photo of your pet or of yourself.

prompts.label: 1. Open [AI Photo with this template](https://www.makeviral.ai/photo?template=the-end-ai-trend&variant=pet) and add your photo (your pet, whole body). The photo prompt is filled in
prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. 9:16 vertical photo, like a real phone photo taken from low down, at the height of a small dog. The pet from the uploaded image stands upright on its two hind legs in the middle of a wide, empty city road of smooth grey asphalt in bright, soft daylight, with a low curb and a sidewalk on the far side; along the sidewalk runs a white metal barrier fence hung with soft pink panels and a few plain pink banners; behind it, green trees and tall city apartment buildings. It stands a few steps from the camera, facing the camera, its front paws held up in front of its chest, ears up, looking into the lens with a cheeky, happy face. Its whole body is in view, from the ears to the hind paws, with its tail. Realistic photo with natural colors and a soft, shallow depth of field. Exactly one animal and no people, no cars. No clothes on the pet. No text, no logos, no watermark, no writing on the banners.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Kling 3.0, 8 s, 1080p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
One continuous shot with no cuts, like a real phone video filmed from low down on a city road in bright daylight. Keep the animal's face, fur, markings, tail and size, and the road, the white fence with the pink panels, the trees and the buildings, exactly as in the image.
0-3 s: the pet walks toward the camera on its two hind legs, like a little person, with small bouncy steps and its front paws up, until its head and chest fill most of the frame.
3-5 s: it stops right in front of the lens, looks into the camera and waves one front paw from side to side: bye-bye.
5-8 s: it turns around and runs away down the middle of the road, still upright on its hind legs, its ears and tail bouncing, getting smaller and smaller until it is far away. The back of the pet has the same fur colors and markings as in the image.
The camera stays low and almost still. Audio: a light, playful original tune and the soft patter of paws on the road; at the very end, a soft, warm off-screen voice whispers: "The end." The pet never speaks and its mouth does not move with the words. Exactly one animal, no people, no cars. No extra animals, no extra legs, no morphing. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 8 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
A playful "the end" clip in one continuous shot with no cuts, like a real phone video filmed from about waist height in bright, soft daylight. Photorealistic.

The person in the clip is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles) and the clothes from [Image 1], so their friends recognize them at once. The face stays the same from the first frame to the last; the hair and the clothes stay the same from the back and in the distance. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the performer is that animal standing upright on its hind legs, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person.

The place: a wide, empty city road of smooth grey asphalt in bright, soft daylight, with a low curb and a sidewalk on the far side; along the sidewalk runs a white metal barrier fence hung with soft pink panels and a few plain pink banners; behind it, green trees and tall city apartment buildings.

0-3 s: the person walks toward the camera down the middle of the road with light, playful steps, from a full-body view to a close shot of the face and chest.
3-5 s: they stop right in front of the lens, look into the camera with a cheeky smile and wave one hand from side to side: bye-bye. The whole face is large and sharp: exactly the face from [Image 1]. Never morph.
5-8 s: they turn around and run away down the road with a happy skip, getting smaller and smaller until they are far away.
The camera stays at the same height and almost still.

Audio: a light, playful original tune and quick footsteps on the road; at the very end, a soft, warm off-screen voice whispers: "The end." The person never speaks. Exactly one performer, no other people, no cars, no extra limbs. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark.
